subject: hermes CORRECTION: P0 PASS veto committed for the first time (13e945f06); main still lacks it
body: Correction + exposure note. The pricesWorseThanMarket PASS hard veto and its 11-test suite existed ONLY as uncommitted working-tree edits - origin/main AND the branch both lacked the line, so the PASS-leak was open on every remote. Now committed and pushed: 13e945f06 on fix/galaxy-odds-first-2026-10-08; verified byte-level on origin; 11/11 tests on the committed state. EXPOSURE: origin/main still lacks the veto until #1156 (or a cherry-pick) lands - flagging because main is the deploy trunk. Also pushed 1bb72fbf8 (remaining overnight worktree edits, WIP-labeled). CI note: first post-merge run mostly green (trust gate, model freeze, import boundary, brand all pass); All guardrails + Dependency audit failing - logs unlock when the run completes.
